PRESIDENT'S ORDER X OF 1983
PRESIDENT'S ORDER X OF 1983
INTERIM ORDERS (PERIOD OF
VALIDITY) ORDER, 1983
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 3rd October, 1983]
No. F. 17(2)/83-Pub.-The
following Order made by the President is hereby published for general
information :-
1. Short title, extent and commencement.--(1) This Order may be
called the Interim (Period of Validity) Order, 1983.
(2) It extends to the Province of
the Punjab.
(3) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: Interim Orders Period of Validity Order 1983
sections.description:
Interim Orders shall cease to have effect after six months

PRESIDENT'S ORDER X OF 1983
PRESIDENT'S ORDER X OF 1983
INTERIM ORDERS (PERIOD OF
VALIDITY) ORDER, 1983
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 3rd October, 1983]
No. F. 17(2)/83-Pub.-The
following Order made by the President is hereby published for general
information :-
2. Interim Orders shall cease to have effect after six months.--(1)
An order made by any Court suspending the operation of, or staying, any order
made, proceeding taken or act done by any authority or person, which has been,
or purports to have been, made, taken or done under the Colonization of
Government Lands (Punjab) Act, 1912 (Punjab Act V of 1912), in respect of any
land granted for the purposes of breeding of horses or mules or the
establishment or maintenance of a stud farm, shall cease to have effect on the
expiration of a period of six months following the day on which it is made,
unless the case is finally decided, or the order is withdrawn, by the Court
earlier.
(2) An order such as is referred
to in clause (1) made by any Court before the commencement of this Order shall
cease to have effect at the expiration of six months from such commencement,
unless the case is finally decided, or the order is withdrawn, by the Court
earlier.
